model_annotation: Figure 3(a) displays the average path length of interlanguage networks and random networks across different proficiency levels. The x-axis is labeled with proficiency levels ranging from A1 to C2, and "mother tongue", with no units specified. The y-axis is labeled "average path length" and ranges from 3.0 to 3.5. The interlanguage network line is red with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at 3.254 at A1, increasing to 3.278 at A2, decreasing to 3.179 at B1, increasing to 3.235 at B2, increasing to 3.294 at C1, and then decreasing to 3.204 at C2, before dropping to approximately 3.1 at "mother tongue". The random network line is blue with square markers and a solid line style, starting at 3.254 at A1 and remaining relatively stable around this value across all other proficiency levels, ending at "mother tongue".
